product_metadata.title: NEW Spill Proof Lid for 30 oz YETI Rambler Tumbler, RTIC, Ozark Trail, and other 30oz stainless steel tumblers | Colored leakproof travel lids (Black)
features: VETERAN OWNED SMALL BUSINESS HAS YOUR BACK – We know what it is like to serve and your satisfaction is our number one priority. If you are not happy for any reason we will make it right guaranteed! PURCHASE IN CONFIDENCE! Manufacture Warranty available when purchased through SEMPR.
100% SPILL & LEAK PROOF – New flip top latch locks in place creating an air tight vacuum seal that keeps liquids in and air out. Protect yourself from spills in the car or on the trail.

PERFECT TRAVEL LID – Let’s face it, spills happen. The SEMPR lid is a great option to prevent spills when on the go. With the SEMPR lid locked in place you can be assured your favorite drink won’t leak a drop if your cup is knocked over.
DESIGNED FOR THE YETI – But the SEMPR lid also fits many other 30 oz. stainless steel tumblers like RTIC, Thermik, Eskimo, Boss, Grid Gear, Ozark Trail and more.
NOTICE: Because the SEMPR lid forms an air tight vacuum seal, some carbonated and very hot beverages may cause the lid to rise off of your tumbler.
description: With just one touch to start and stop whenever you want, the instecho Electric Can Opener automatically opens your cans in seconds. The small but mighty opens any size can's lid whether small, medium or large--and it cuts from the side so it doesn't leave any sharp edges.
☇ One touch start and stop feature for hands-free opening
☇ Automatically open cans in seconds, operated by 2*AA batteries (Not Included)
☇ Sleek, low profile design for easy storage
☇ Hygienic - Cuts from side of can without leaving sharp edges, lid will never falls into can and touch on food
Step1 - Place the Can Opener on top of the can with its rim positioned in the groove between the Cutter and the Drive Wheel
Step2 - With the can on a flat surface, press the Button for about one second and release, then the Can Opener will start cutting the side of the can
Step3 - When the cutting has completed, press the button immediately to reverse the cutter
Step4 - Make sure that the cutter resets to the start position and the motor stops. Then, lift the can opener off the can

1. If batteries are depleted, the can may not be released by pressing the button. Slide back the Battery Door and replace 2 AA batteries. The Can Opener should continue the cutting. Remember to replace the battery.
2. Cans with heavy seams and uneven rims may stall the Can Opener. If this happens, follow above procedure to release the can.
3. If the can is get stuck, please press the white button on the top of the can opener.
